meta.name: pop-up-book-illustration
meta.description: 生成3D纸艺弹出书风格插画，具备立体层次感、明亮温暖色调，适用于科技、教育、品牌展示等场景

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成3D纸艺弹出书风格插画
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在项目中加入立体纸艺风格的视觉元素
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add 3D papercraft style visuals to your projects

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会生成具有立体层次和纸质纹理的 3D 纸艺弹出书风格插画，使用薄荷绿、天蓝、珊瑚橙、奶油黄等明亮温暖色调，并可融入柔和霓虹光效等科技元素。
howto.when: 当你要求生成具有纸艺质感、立体层次、特定色调（薄荷绿/天蓝/珊瑚橙/奶油黄）的插画时触发。

say.text: 生成一张科技主题的3D纸艺弹出书插画，展示AI大脑。
say.note: 会得到立体弹出书风格的AI大脑图像。

say.text: 画一个教育主题的弹出书，知识树从书页中弹出。
say.note: 会得到多层立体知识树插画。

say.text: 为我的品牌产品生成一张弹出书风格展示图。
say.note: 会得到品牌产品在弹出书中的展示。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will generate 3D pop-up book style illustrations with paper texture, layered depth, and bright warm colors (mint green, sky blue, coral orange, cream yellow), optionally incorporating soft neon glow and tech elements.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you request an illustration with paper craft texture, layered depth, and specific warm tones (mint green/sky blue/coral orange/cream yellow).

say_en.text: Generate a tech-themed 3D pop-up book illustration showing an AI brain.
say_en.note: You'll get a pop-up book style AI brain image.

say_en.text: Draw an educational pop-up book with a knowledge tree popping out.
say_en.note: You'll get a multi-layered knowledge tree illustration.

say_en.text: Create a pop-up book style display for my brand product.
say_en.note: You'll get the product showcased in a pop-up book.
